sub_site: BALT lymphoma tissue (FFPE); non-cancerous lung tissue comparator

evidence.quote: A total of 21 FFPE tissue samples obtained from 16 patients were utilized in this study.
16S rRNA gene was amplified by polymerase chain reaction. Amplicons were sequenced using a Nanopore platform.

notes: Analysis reported only at family level (Burkholderiaceae, Bacillaceae etc.); no genus names in results; no supplements available. Nanopore full-length 16S, WIMP classification. 12 BALT lymphoma + 9 non-cancerous lung FFPE (both target sites). Seven lung carcinoma samples mentioned, data not shown.
